title: Sleeping Beauty — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
The honest version of Sleeping Beauty starts by giving up the comforting part. A good fairy, knowing the princess would be frightened if alone when she wakes, uses her wand to put every living person and animal in the palace and forest asleep, to awaken when the princess does. This was later adapted in French by Charles Perrault in Histoires ou contes du temps passé in 1697.

Every serious account of Sleeping Beauty eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. One day, the new King must go to war against his neighbor, Emperor Contalabutte, and leaves his mother to govern the kingdom and look after his family. After her son leaves, the Ogress Queen Mother sends her daughter-in-law to a house secluded in the woods and orders her cook to prepare Morning with Sauce Robert for dinner.
